import random
from pathlib import Path

path_reads = [path.read_text() for path in [Path("state")]]
generators = [factory() for factory in [random.Random]]
path_set = {path.read_text() for path in [Path("state")]}
path_map = {path.name: path.read_text() for path in [Path("state")]}
path_generator = (path.read_text() for path in [Path("state")])

list_factory = int
[(list_factory := random.Random) for _ in [0]]
list_factory()
set_factory = int
{(set_factory := random.Random) for _ in [0]}
set_factory()
dict_factory = int
{_: (dict_factory := random.Random) for _ in [0]}
dict_factory()
generator_factory = int
list((generator_factory := random.Random) for _ in [0])
generator_factory()
filter_factory = int
[None for _ in [0] if (filter_factory := random.Random)]
filter_factory()
